name: Search Visibility
description: Improve organic search visibility through technical diagnosis, intent research, information architecture, content quality, structured data, and measured iteration.

tasks.name: Establish search baseline
tasks.objective: Inventory site sections, analytics/search-console equivalents, crawl/index coverage, templates, rankings or visibility, branded/nonbranded demand, conversions, and known migrations or penalties.

tasks.name: Audit technical discoverability
tasks.objective: Check crawlability, indexing directives, canonicals, redirects, sitemaps, rendering, status codes, duplicate/parameter handling, pagination, internationalization, structured data, performance, and mobile/accessibility basics.

tasks.name: Map search intent and information architecture
tasks.objective: Research query families and user tasks, group by intent rather than string similarity alone, map existing pages, find gaps/cannibalization, and define page purpose and internal-link relationships.

tasks.name: Improve content and templates
tasks.objective: Strengthen usefulness, evidence, originality, headings, titles/descriptions, media alternatives, internal links, entity/context clarity, and structured data where valid. Remove or consolidate thin duplication when justified.

tasks.name: Validate implementation
tasks.objective: Recrawl representative templates, test rendered pages, indexability, canonicals, structured data, links, page experience, tracking, and migration rules before and after release.

tasks.name: Measure and iterate
tasks.objective: Track visibility, clicks, qualified traffic, conversions, index coverage, page/template trends, and query intent shifts over appropriate windows; document algorithm/seasonality limits and next tests.
